title: client_config.access
description: Access of the device: member or guest, set when pairing and never changed. Guests: expires_at is the hub's authoritative end (no own cap in the apps; the hub limits a grant to guest_access.max_hours of data/profile-rules.json and announces an extension with guest_extended / client_config_updated). After expires_at the hub rejects the device (auth_error guest_expired) and the app locks everything (fail closed). hours = access right now (access hours, access switch). request = “Ask for early access”.

expires_at.description: Guests: end of the access (always set). Members: null.

set_up_by.description: Member device that set up this device (confirmed its onboarding or invited it as a guest), only as the device may show it: name and method, never the client_id of that device. null or missing after the admin PIN.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the hub (Home Assistant's time_zone; UTC when Home Assistant names none or an unknown one). The windows of the rule access_hours are in this zone: the app computes every window edge (the next window start after until, the end of a window it opens by itself) in it, never in the device's own zone. Sent to every device, also without access hours.

hours.description: Access right now (access hours and access switch). open false: the device stays paired, the hub sends no areas, states or quick access entries and refuses control (rule_blocked access_closed), ha_token and ha_url are null; the app shows only “Access again from {opens_at}” (or “No access right now” without opens_at). The hub sends client_config_updated at every change (window start/end, switch). The app also switches on its own at until/opens_at.

request.description: Present while the effective rule access_requests is on.
